test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. B sits fourth to the right of E. C sits third to the right of B. A sits sixth to the left of E. There are only two persons between C and D. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
**Given: **

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north.

**Solution:**

(1) B sits fourth to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb4a1d0cdc50ac4ab6c5b702157765ffba16898aa6900f002b894e37b139defb.png] 

(2) C sits third to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30c448115fb789e06e1c7ef610f7123396bd2d6ff8316d1e0e0679cad9c3ebdd.png] 

(3) A sits sixth to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6320c2e3f45f723568c9df46e2ef7dc5c13bed8acee3f9164bb94f3eecf2b88c.png] 

(4) There are only two persons between C and D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3444f13575706c2365a5866861eb69be42b211e9377085eb7ef4a23724a08fbf.png] 

Here is 17 persons seated.

Hence, **'option 3'** is the correct answer.
